column1: # Diet spellings (diet-food-words/3): the old and variant spellings of the recipe corpus (cocoanut, cinamon, sirup, chesnut, shalot, yelk) read as the curated catalog's word, derived from the corpus, never listed by hand (review ck16-4 and owner question 2 of build/ck16-diet-known.md: "cinamon" held 58566 although its lines carry cinnamon). DietFoodWords.Normal reads a spelling of this file as its word.

# Derivation, on the read-only staging copy of 2026-11-25: every word of a live line (DietFoodWords.AllWords) that no live curated food holds (name, USDA description, trusted aliases) and that has at least four letters; kept when a word the curated catalog holds differs from it by one letter (inserted, dropped, changed, or two neighbours swapped), starts with the same letter, and at least half of the lines that hold the spelling and are on a live curated food (at least 3) are on curated foods that hold that word; the word most of them hold is taken. A spelling no line on a curated food carries (pye, pistachia) is not read: it stays not understood.
# lines: the live lines that hold the spelling; recipes: their recipes; curated: those lines on a live curated food; word lines: those on a curated food that holds the word.
